about.text: A semi-hard pressed cheese from La Mancha, made from a blend of sheep, goat and cow milk, similar to Manchego in texture and flavour but with more goat and cow notes. It was counted as Manchego until 1985, when that name was limited to sheep's-milk cheese, and it is sold in wax-coated wheels.
